ctaHeading: Landscaping in Greenvale? Let's create your dream garden.
aboutText: Evergreen Landscaping has been crafting stunning outdoor spaces in Greenvale and Melbourne's northern suburbs for over a decade. We specialise in using native and local plants to design sustainable, low-maintenance gardens that thrive in the local climate. From retaining walls to complete courtyard makeovers, our team delivers high-quality, tailored solutions for every property.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of landscaping services in Greenvale and surrounding areas. Whether you need a new native garden, a sturdy retaining wall, or a complete outdoor renovation, our skilled team can bring your vision to life with precision and care.

services.title: Native & Local Planting
services.desc: We use indigenous plants to create eco-friendly gardens that support local biodiversity and require less water, perfect for Melbourne's climate.

services.title: Retaining Wall Construction
services.desc: Built to last, our retaining walls provide structural support and enhance the aesthetic appeal of your sloped garden or property.

services.title: Outdoor Entertainment Areas
services.desc: Design and build functional spaces like fire pits, decks, and seating for relaxing and entertaining in your Greenvale backyard.

services.title: Garden Renovations
services.desc: Revitalise your existing garden with new layouts, plantings, and features to boost curb appeal and enjoyment for your home.

services.title: Tree Planting & Care
services.desc: Professional tree planting and maintenance services to add shade, privacy, and beauty to your landscape in Greenvale.

services.title: Raised Garden Beds
services.desc: Custom-designed raised beds for easy gardening, ideal for herbs, vegetables, or ornamental plants in your outdoor space.
